plugins.description: Continuous tracking for large work items and agent teams, with sourced events, durable state, progress and no-progress reports, worker nudges, recovery, and Markdown, Mermaid, and accessible HTML views.

Azure DevOps integration for work item management, PR publishing, iterative PR tending, autonomous work item implementation, and autonomous backlog processing. Orchestrates development methodology skills via the development plugin.

GitHub integration for issue and project management, PR publishing, iterative PR tending, issue-driven implementation, and autonomous backlog processing. Orchestrates development methodology skills via the development plugin.

Development methodology toolkit with Agile team delivery for large, long-horizon features. The agile-development skill coordinates thin end-to-end slices, durable progress state, early and continuous manual testing, observed-defect regression tests, behavioral tests for material acceptance contracts, final coverage review, verification, and final review. Includes Architect, Manual Tester, Developer, Critic, and blind-spot agents; design-first brainstorming; autonomous design; scenario-driven development as the default testing flow (manual testing from the first runnable slice, defect regressions, behavioral contract tests, then coverage-guided tests after all scenarios pass), with TDD as an explicit opt-in; subagent-driven execution; course-correction when fixes stack; compound-learning lessons read back at plan time; hooks that block git bypasses and untested completion; completion verification; code-review triage; work-item drafting; and provider-agnostic work-on and implement workflows.
Developer performance review skill for analyzing work over time (weeks/months)

Code review toolkit with a general Code Reviewer agent for independent feature and merge-readiness review, built as a funnel: a cheap eligibility gate, deterministic review tiering, a shared context pack, a correctness lane and repo-history lane alongside specialized agents for duplicate detection, EUII leak scanning, exception handling, test coverage, design and code simplification, over-engineering and scope creep, architecture, performance, schema and wire compatibility, and feature-flag rollout. Findings are mechanically anchored to the diff, adversarially verified before posting, then synthesized into root causes, graded for severity and merge-blocking lane, and sequenced into an ordered fix plan, with each agent declaring the model-intelligence tier its work actually needs. Includes provider-aware review automation, structured comment publishing, and batch PR review orchestration.
Microsoft Orleans patterns, best practices, and code review for virtual actor model applications — covers grain design, concurrency, cross-grain communication, streams, and serialization.
Achieve zero-warning builds through systematic warning elimination, code formatting, and package version validation

Log-first debugging methodology using structured JSONL logs queried with DuckDB. Includes debugging workflows, logging enablement for codebases, logging compliance review with calibrated Trace-coverage recommendations for AI-assisted debugging, and systematic root-cause debugging.
Install and configure HITL, connect Inbox or the tray client, and guide cross-device questions, plan reviews, end-of-work handoffs, notifications, and durable progress through automatic usage hooks.
